about_the_game:
This is a visual novel about memories and stars.
Set in a fantastical world of constellations, it tells the story of a journey guided by fate.

When he awakens, he finds himself lying alone on a beach beneath a sky full of stars.
The sound of the waves greets him, and so does the voice of a mysterious traveler.
According to the traveler, these constellations will not last much longer.

Led by the traveler, he sets out on a journey across the realm of stars.
Along the way, he encounters people born from the constellations, each carrying their own memories and feelings that leave a lasting mark on his heart.
In time, he must face two questions: What is the true nature of this world?
And what choice has fate entrusted to him?

short_description: I awoke on a lonely shore beneath a sky of countless stars. A mysterious traveler appeared, speaking of constellations soon to fade. Together, we set out on a journey— to meet new people, uncover the truth of this world, and face the choice that awaits me. An adventure of stars and memories begins.
